Test for a grasp reflex in the hand.
Test for a snout, palmomental, or glabellar tap reflex.
Check for orthostatic hypotension (measure supine and standing blood pressure and heart rate).

DIAGNOSIS: LGI1 antibody-associated autoimmune (limbic) encephalitis
